feeds.title: JROCK News
feeds.description: Our goal is to provide up to date news to Jrock fans around the world with our international team of dedicated and passionate writers. JROCK NEWS writers are spread internationally to bring you local and global news about update tours, gigs, and events in the Japanese rock culture. We're supported and maintained by volunteers and have brought people who love Japanese rock together from all over the world, enticing artists to perform aboard, connecting fans to artists, all to share our passion with people who also love Japanese rock music.

feeds.title: Niche Music
feeds.description: Niche Music is a specialized site that introduces indie music from around the world with the theme of 'Western music is also cool'. We are excavating every day to deliver the presence of bands/artists who are active in unfamiliar countries as well as UK and US.

feeds.title: ADSR Collective
feeds.description: The latest DJ mixes, interviews, and electronic music from our blog and record label. From supporting underground artists on our blog, to releasing music we believe in on our label based in Vancouver, Canada and Tokyo, Japan, the ADSR collective aims to provide authentic content and commentary in today's electronic music landscape.

feeds.title: TenForward Music Blog
feeds.description: TenForward Music Blog covers articles on Jazz, Fusion, Progressive Rock, K-POP, Metal music.

feeds.title: YUKIO Music Blog
feeds.description: YUKIO Music is a music blog by me, Yukio. I'm Japanese. I would like to spread my original songs to the world. Here I share all my music videos and stories, I believe you will be able to understand my soul even with my Japanese words which are foreign languages to you if you kindly listen to my music.

feeds.title: Electric Bloom Webzine
feeds.description: Delve into the latest Japanese music releases, iconic classics, and emerging trends across various genres within the vibrant Japanese music scene. Electric Bloom Webzine (エレクトリックブルーム) is an England-based news website bringing Japanese music coverage to the UK.

feeds.title: Japan Music Corner
feeds.description: I want to popularize Japanese music - J-pop, enka, and jazz, etc, to the world. I want to highlight the talented but more obscure and unknown performers.

feeds.title: Tokyo Jazz Site Blog
feeds.description: Tokyo Jazz Site Blog is a guide to Jazz bars, clubs, cafes, and shops in the Tokyo and Yokohama metropolitan areas, home of the OK Jazz podcast, plus info on Soul and World Music.

feeds.title: Vif
feeds.description: ROCK's comprehensive information site Vif is full of information such as artist interviews and live reports! In their blog section, you can find information about the different Japanese music artists and what they're doing, three new albums, music launches, live concerts, and more!

feeds.title: uDiscoverMusic.jp
feeds.description: The Japanese version of uDiscovermusic, a site that introduces foreign music. Introducing the latest news of big Western music bands such as The Beatles, Queen, and Stones, new artists, inside stories of past masterpieces, exclusive interviews and quizzes, and ranking articles of albums and artists.

feeds.title: JJazz.Net Blog
feeds.description: JJazz.Net blog is a Japanese blog that informs on topics like Masatake Unno New York Trio The long-awaited JAPAN TOUR has been decided, My First Jazz Vol.55-Mikiko Nagatake, live performances, and many more!

feeds.title: Far Side Music
feeds.description: Paul Fisher is an expert and enthusiast for all types of Asian music and culture. He lived in Japan for 11 years, where he started farsidemusic.com. Discover the Music and Culture of Japan and East Asia with his articles.

feeds.title: Leap250's Blog
feeds.description: Leap250's blog is a Japanese music blog that mainly features articles, music reviews and other much more info related to the music scene in Japan.

feeds.title: Music & Copyright's Blog » Japan
feeds.description: Music & Copyright's Blog provides the international business news service of global music copyright. Stay up to date with the music industry news from Japan, copyright laws and more!

feeds.title: Chromatic Dreamers Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nostalgia. I'm an Intermediate Rhythm Guitarist and I've been a big Japanese Music Fan since 2006. I took music through school, so I've dabble in other instruments, sang in choir, and performed with my school's drumline. I picked up guitar as an adult to bring my band dream to life and achieved that through my rookie band project in 2022.Now in 2023, I'm dividing into composing and producing. On this blog, I share music theory lessons, J-music insight, band tips, and much more!

feeds.title: NME JAPAN Blogs
feeds.description: NME Japan is the Japanese version of the British music website NME.com. We provide all kinds of information related to music/rock, including the latest local news, local reviews, music videos, celebrity gossip, and live reports, focusing on Western music.

feeds.title: Metropolis Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Your guide to music in Tokyo. Artist interviews, concert reviews and cultural critiques. From rock to requiem, Japanese musicians and international names. Metropolis was founded in 1994 as Tokyo Classified, a compendium of casual and professional English-language ads distributed with the Daily Yomiuri newspaper. Rebranded as Metropolis in 2001, the magazine is now independently owned by Japan Partnership Holdings Inc.

feeds.title: ARAMA! Japan » Music
feeds.description: Read the latest J-pop and Japanese music news and reviews by ARAMA! Japan. ARAMA! JAPAN is an entertainment blog that provides complete coverage of Japanese pop culture of music, celebrities, anime and everything in between.

feeds.title: Jpop Recommend
feeds.description: My weekly recommendation for all-time best Japanese pop music, ballad, rock.Let's learn Japanese through Jpop lyrics!

feeds.title: Sync Network Japan
feeds.description: Latest music news, concerts, shows, and new releases on Sync Network Japan. With the theme 'JAPANESE MUSIC TO THE WORLD', Sync Network Japan promotes the globalization of music content. We seek to increase visitors and expand Japanese content globally.

feeds.title: From Japan » Music
feeds.description: Read the latest news and information on music and Japanese music. The From Japan Blog is your source for news and info about Japanese anime, fashion, idols, toys, comics, food, and more.

feeds.title: Clear And Refreshing
feeds.description: Pop, indie and underground music in Japan. Clear And Refreshing is a dumping ground for thoughts, reviews, and links related to music in Japan. My name's Ian Martin and I'm a British immigrant living in Tokyo. I also run an indie/post-punk label called Call And Response Records, and help organise frequent live events and DJ parties, mostly in Tokyo but also sometimes in other parts of Japan.

feeds.title: More Than Music Blog
feeds.description: Check out the newest music talents from Japan, news, albums and singles and more! Our aim is to support the music by creating high quality events that are unforgettable for all that get involved and supporting talented musicians in creating ways to get their music heard by a new audience.

feeds.title: Tokyo Weekender » Music
feeds.description: Latest music news, concerts, shows, reviews and playlist on Tokyo Weekender.Tokyo Weekender is Tokyo's longest-running English lifestyle magazine, packed with food, travel, tips, city guides, news, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Japanese Music Blog
feeds.description: The latest news for international fans, including local CD releases, overseas tour dates, live streams, and more. JPU Records is a multi-award-winning Japanese music record label based in London, UK. We help get bands from Japan the recognition they deserve overseas, while also making their music easier to own on CD, vinyl, tape cassette, and even MiniDisc!

feeds.title: Japan Music Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news and updates from Japan music industry, artists, bands and more! Check out the reviews, opinions and more!

feeds.title: The Japan Times » Music
feeds.description: Full coverage of Japan's music scene as well as overseas artists touring Japan.The Japan Times offers latest news and features from Japan: business, politics, commentary culture, life & style, entertainment and sports
